roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital dual role involves leading staff education initiatives and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control within our facility. You will play a crucial part in fostering a knowledgeable and safe environment for both residents and staff.In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for clinical staff, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements, and promoting continuous professional growth. Concurrently, you will oversee all aspects of infection control, including surveillance, policy development, and outbreak management, safeguarding the health and well-being of our community.This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence. If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and patient safety, we encourage you to apply and become a key member of our compassionate team.
requirements: Proven experience in staff development and education
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40-$42 per hour, based on experience.
